messages:
Aisha M.: Quick SEO standup for the webinar + launch hub. Need final redirect list, schema snippets, and an internal-link insertion plan before publish.
Julia K.: Goal: minimize click friction from hub -> webinar signup. Also protect the hub for evergreen keyword value.
Tom B.: Suggestion: short redirect whitelist only for legacy marketing paths. No regex. I'll keep it to 4 lines. Example CSV: 
```
/old-signup-form, /events/2026/fast-inference
/getting-started-llm, /guides/llm-getting-started
/kvcache-post, /learn/kv-cache-best-practices
/2025-release-notes, /resources/release-2026-05
```
Priya S.: For canonicalization I prefer: hub canonical -> webinar as separate page. That way the hub retains SERP for key evergreen queries, webinar competes for "webinar" keywords. We can run a quick 48h impression test after publish.
Julia K.: Let's document that as an A/B possibility but default to hub-canonical for launch. We discussed variants last month.
Tom B.: Ok default hub canonical. We'll add rel=canonical on webinar pointing back to hub? wait that's reversed..
Aisha M.: No, implement hub page <link rel=canonical href="/learn/webinar-hub" /> and webinar page has self-canonical. Hub links to webinar with descriptive anchor.
seo-checker-bot: Schema scan: missing Event.startDate on /events/2026/fast-inference and missing BreadcrumbList on /learn/webinar-hub.
Priya S.: I'll add JSON-LD event block with startDate (ISO 8601, UTC) and organizer/name. Also FAQ schema on the webinar page (pull Qs from prep doc).
Julia K.: FAQ owner = Priya. Redirects owner = Tom. Internal anchor owner = Aisha. Monitoring = Julia + Tom for Search Console inspections.
Tom B.: I'll push redirects to seo/redirects_launch_may2026.csv and request a quick lambda test. Also will include a small unit test that checks no redirect targets loop back to /old-.*
Aisha M.: Anchor text plan: use mixed branded + descriptive anchors: e.g., "Redwood Inference webinar: serving LLMs with low latency" and one simplified "Webinar: LLM serving best practices". Limit identical anchors to 2 pages.
Priya S.: Keywords to seed in hub copy: "inference cost optimization", "batching strategies for inference", "low-latency model serving". I'll sprinkle long-tail variants in filterable content modules.
Julia K.: Design note: ask design to render FAQ accordions with visible schema-friendly markup. Use <script type="application/ld+json"> snippets in head.
seo-checker-bot: Preflight run requested by Julia K. — results: BreadcrumbList missing on hub, Event.startDate missing on event, FAQ accepted but flagged for duplicate Qs across two FAQ blocks.
Tom B.: I'll fix redirects and re-run preflight after Priya pushes schema. Targeting publish Tuesday 09:00 PT.
Aisha M.: Quick ops question: do we want hreflang on hub for EU region copy? We don't have translated pages yet.
Priya S.: Not yet. We'll add hreflang when regional pages exist. For now add canonical + regional meta to avoid accidental geotargeting.
Julia K.: Great. Final checklist: redirects CSV in repo, schema JSON-LD validated, FAQ drafted and deduped, anchor links placed in 10 priority hub pages, preflight green. If green, schedule publish 09:00 PT Tue.
Tom B.: I'll watch Search Console for crawl errors in first 2 hours and post any 5xx/redirect loops here.
Julia K.: Thanks team — action items noted. Will follow up with rollout doc and a short post-mortem channel thread after live.
